sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: A jump of the computer's clock (a time sync, a virtual machine catching up, waking from sleep) no longer cuts short or stretches a wait in the shared MusicBrainz request gate: the page now counts every wait on a clock that never jumps, while the times it shares with other tabs and scripts stay as they were.

Another script's "I am drawing a page" mark in the shared gate holds the page's background MusicBrainz requests for at most 10 s from the moment the page first saw it, so a broken or far-future mark can no longer stall them for minutes; a renewed mark still holds them again.
